scope: Preregistered operating evidence and margin response policy; no new equity value calculated. Existing historical and scenario values were visible in inherited files, so not valuation-blind.
anchor_rule: Pool Q2 and Q3 2026 DCAI revenue/profit and Other revenue; infer a CPU operating-profit residual conditional on a20% Other margin. Do not select only highest Q3. Q1/YTD and Q2-only remain alternative anchor checks.
mature_policy: Prefer preservation of the pooled Q2+Q3 CPU operating-profit residual, with mature blended DCAI margin computed from explicit future CPU/Other revenue weights. Do not force blended40% when Other share changes. CPU residual is an allocation assumption, not a disclosed CPU margin or through-cycle empirical floor.
phase_rule: Root may hold the near-term calibrated group EBIT path through2030. From2031 linearly phase the implied2030CPU margin to the selected pooled-current CPU residual by2040 while applying20% Other margin. Use actual projected mix each year. Do not separately apply an old matureblend uplift on top.
near_term_cost_rationale: Public Q3 consolidated product-profit improvement/revenue growth is about56%; YTD about41%. These broad mixed-company measures contextualize50% but do not measure pure unit or price elasticity. Fixed factories can create larger lost-sale impact; stress75/100% with capex and depreciation retained.
group_allocation_rule: The50% is TOTAL incremental/decremental group EBIT, including manufacturing contribution. Holding displayed Foundry dollars is an allocation convention, not an assertion factories are unaffected. Do not add a second factory-absorption loss unless replacing the total coefficient. Internal transfer-price changes alone cancel.
Other_DCAI_growth_policy: Evaluate broad Other as custom-silicon growth plus remaining legacy/network components. Preserve existing2026E/Q4 anchor initially and compute implied custom-share hurdles; do not automatically apply triple-growth statement to all Other. Selection to be completed before root values it.
growth_scope: Quarterly delivery agent owns revised2027 and2028–30 units andASP policy. No independent longtermCPU market forecast identified; mature margin cannot be validated by demandgrowth alone.
